summary: Iteration 1 full-stack test of MBGG PWA. Backend: 26/26 pytest pass (auth, roles, subscriber gating, free check-in, monthly token + ack, game logs validation/grouping/delete, leaderboards metrics incl. win-rate, collections, public members, payments link creation for all 8 products, PWA assets). Frontend: registration/login/logout, nonsub gates, subscriber check-in, token use, game log dialog + per-game tabs + delete, leaderboards game/metric tabs (win rate min 3 enforced), collections add/delete (digital requires platform), public profile logged-out, members search, admin Host nav/badge/tabs/ack/promote+demote, Square navigation for check-in/raffle/donation/annual/gate subscribe, checkout-complete pending view, rails at 1920 + ticker/mobile menu at 390 all working. No payments were completed. One real backend bug found: Square rejects some buyer emails and the whole checkout fails.

minor.issue: pre_populated_data.buyer_email is always sent. Square production rejects emails it considers invalid (e.g. any @example.com address) with INVALID_EMAIL_ADDRESS, so the endpoint returns 400 'Square couldn't start the checkout' and that user can't pay for anything. Fix: on an INVALID_EMAIL_ADDRESS error, retry without pre_populated_data, or leave buyer_email out entirely. Reproduced with TEST_x@example.com (400); TEST_x@gmail.com works (200).
Every click makes a new Square payment link and a new PENDING record (two annual clicks = two links). Consider reusing a recent PENDING link for the same user+product.
The rate limit is per email only (5 failed attempts per 15 min), so anyone can lock out the admin account by entering wrong passwords. Consider limiting by IP + email.

ui_bugs.issue: The default date uses the browser's local timezone (new Date().toLocaleDateString('en-CA')) but check-ins are stored with Adelaide dates. Reproduced: at 01:27 Adelaide time (UTC browser) the roster defaulted to 2026-11-13 and showed '0 checked in', while today's check-in was stored as 2026-11-14. Use toLocaleDateString('en-CA', {timeZone: 'Australia/Adelaide'}).

The default played_at date and the date input's max also use the browser's local date instead of Adelaide. Logs get yesterday's date (UTC), and users in timezones ahead of Adelaide can pick a date the backend rejects.
After clicking 'Got it' on a token alert, nav-admin-alert-count still shows 1 until the next 30s poll. Refresh the summary right after ack.

issues: game-rail-ticker is drawn above widescreen-logo-header, so the widescreen logo is not at the top of the page on mobile/tablet. Move the ticker below the header.
Uses the browser's native <input type=date> instead of the shadcn Calendar/Popover date picker

action_items: Handle Square INVALID_EMAIL_ADDRESS in create_checkout: retry without pre_populated_data.buyer_email, or drop it
Use the Australia/Adelaide date for the admin check-in roster default and for the LogGameDialog default/max date
Refresh the nav admin alert count right after a token ack
Move the mobile game-rail-ticker below the widescreen logo header
Optional: replace native date inputs with the shadcn Calendar; fix plural labels; IP-based login rate limit
critical_code_review_comments: server.py create_checkout: buyer_email pre-population makes checkout fragile (see backend minor issue)
server.py login: the per-email lockout can be abused to DoS the admin login
Leaderboard win-rate minimum (3 plays) is only enforced in the frontend; the API returns win_rate for every row, which is fine but should be documented
Frontend date defaults (Admin.js line 46, LogGameDialog.js today()) ignore the Adelaide timezone the backend uses
/api/members is public and returns every user (no pagination, limit 1000); email is correctly excluded

success_rate.backend: 100% (26/26) - one robustness bug found while testing (Square email)
success_rate.frontend: ~95% - every flow worked; timezone default bug in the admin roster
